Inside, the cabin welcomes you with comfortable front bucket seats, a center console with electronic transmission range selector, and a heated steering wheel for those cooler mornings. The dual-zone automatic climate control keeps both driver and passenger comfortable, while the power-adjustable heated mirrors and LED cargo lighting add practical convenience. Technology is seamlessly integrated throughout the cabin. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System offers intuitive control, while the premium Bose 7-speaker audio system delivers clear sound for your favorite stations, including SiriusXM 360L. The 12.3' multicolor reconfigurable digital display puts essential driving information right in your line of sight. Wireless charging and WiFi hotspot capability keep your devices powered and connected while you work or travel. Safety features provide peace of mind on every journey. Automatic emergency braking, Forward Collision Alert, and Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning work together to help protect you and your passengers. The HD rear vision camera and hitch guidance with hitch view make backing up and towing easier and safer. This truck is also equipped with a comprehensive array of airbags, stability control, and traction control systems. When it comes to capability, this Silverado means business. The integrated trailer brake controller and trailering package equip this truck to handle towing responsibilities. The power sliding rear window with defogger improves visibility, and the frame-mounted recovery hooks provide practical utility. With 79,169 miles on the odometer, this truck has proven reliability while still offering years of service ahead. This 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 RST represents a smart choice for buyers who want a full-size truck that balances performance, technology, and everyday practicality. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this truck firsthand and discover why it's the right fit for your needs.
